strings: m_c makes a weak, very bad joke about {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} tail smelling like Twoleg food. Gently, r_c breaks the news that {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} burned flesh is going to need to be removed.
m_c's tail was almost completely taken by the fire. r_c tells {PRONOUN/m_c/object} that at this point it would be better to cleanly remove what still remains.
m_c's burnt tail had long since ceased to feel like a real part of {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} body except for the pain. m_c is almost glad to be rid of it. Almost.
